title: BMI Calculator
description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and see which weight category it falls into.

faqs.question: What is a healthy BMI range?
faqs.answer: For most adults, a BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is considered a healthy weight range, though it doesn't account for muscle mass or body composition.

faqs.question: Is BMI accurate for everyone?
faqs.answer: BMI is a general screening tool and may not accurately reflect body composition for athletes, older adults, or pregnant individuals. It's not a diagnosis — consult a healthcare provider for personalized advice.
